messages:
tom-partners: Quick thread  Plan: Datadog Marketplace tile + embargo playbook for joint HW/SI launches. Need checklist for dashboard vetting, privacy language, and partner onboarding flow. cc @rina-obs @paul-se
rina-obs: For the dashboard vetting: include a trace sampling guide (recommended: 1% global + 100% error traces) and a section on GPU-specific metrics (gpu_util, mem_alloc_mb, infer_latency_p50/p95).
paul-se: SE asks: can we provide a demo STAGING Datadog org and a scripted importer? I can create a small demo that imports dashboards and replay traces.
emily-legal: Embargo/legal notes: add an embargo window (72h pre-announce lock), approved quote template, and a telemetry consent blurb for EU customers. Also require opt-out instructions for telemetry sharing.
jun-ops: Ops checklist: sign the dashboard JSON, validate dashboards import via API, provide helm chart for otelcol config. Minimal otelcol snippet to include in docs: 
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: $DD_API_KEY
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
paul-se: Nice snippet. Also add a sample trace payload for LLM requests with fields: request_id, model, token_count, cache_hit (bool), shard_id. Helps partners map traces to model internals.
rina-obs: I'll own the validation matrix for dashboards (functional smoke tests + perf thresholds). Example checks: dashboards load in <3s, p95 latency panel matches query, tokenized spans count present.
tom-partners: Marketing/launch: partner wants a co-branded tile and a short demo. Target: soft launch to partner customers, public press after 2 weeks. Need comms owner.
emily-legal: Also include data residency toggle in the quickstart: redact prompt_text by default, show how to enable full traces with customer consent. I'll draft wording in repo PR.
jun-ops: CI note: pipeline started for repo rw/marketplace-dd-tile (build #1) - integration tests will try importing dashboard to staging account.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline rw/marketplace-dd-tile build #1 queued -> running
paul-se: I'll prepare the staged org and importer script. Expect initial PR by Fri.
tom-partners: Great. Sync scheduled Tue 9am PT to approve tile + embargo text. Agenda: dashboard QA, legal copy, staging importer, demo script. :calendar:
